title: tan x < 1 on 0° ≤ x < 180°
caption: The boundary is x = 45°, where tan x = 1. On the first branch tan x < 1 for x < 45°; on the second branch (90° < x < 180°) tan x is negative, so always below 1. The point 90° is excluded: tan is undefined there.
alt: A number line from 0° to 180° with a shaded interval from 0° to 45°, closed at 0° and open at 45°, and another from 90° to 180°, open at both ends.
description: Mark the boundary x = 45°, where tan x = 1, and the excluded point x = 90°.
From 0° up to 45°, tan x is below 1: 0° ≤ x < 45°.
Between 90° and 180°, tan x is negative, so tan x < 1 throughout.
The solution is 0° ≤ x < 45° or 90° < x < 180°.
